description: Week 32 (2026-11-02 to 2026-11-09; Dr. Luitel, 2026-11-02: spectrogram models only, only refits reported, speaker-specific against session-specific, scripted against improvised): the SVM probe probe30_whisper_large_v3_so4 (4c19be6604d3), its layer fixed, in speaker-specific folds (one speaker tests, the other speaker of the same session validates, the other eight speakers train), refitted on training plus validation; C and gamma are chosen on each fold's validation set as the probe chooses them.
